about_the_game:
The Light Charmer - Manipulate the last of the Light Wisps to save a kingdom from destruction!

This is a meat-pigeon tower defense game in which you manipulate the Light Wisps to fight. Players will take on the role of Liana, the deceased princess, and manipulate the last legacy of the kingdom, the Light Wisps, to repel enemies and revive the kingdom.

The game is centered on “free combinations”, and players can experience a wide variety of gameplay in the game. Whether it's forming an unbreakable position, maneuvering a hand-crafted unique Light Wisps to kill enemies from a distance, or controlling the power of the elements ------, the fate of Liana will be written by the players themselves through every choice they make.

The game provides dozens of defense towers, hundreds of kinds of reinforcement and thousands of kinds of Light Wisps & Light Shards with the way, not only is the test of the player's technology and strategy, but also a stage to release the imagination. According to your own lineup, construct the lineup according to the time, form your perfect bulid and repel the incoming enemies!

Characters

Liana: Once a princess of the Radiance Kingdom and a survivor of the "Night of Broken Radiance", she was exiled to the kingdom's borders with her guards at the age of one after the kingdom's destruction. Unaware of the monsters' schemes, she could have lived an ordinary life until one day, when her village was attacked by kobolds, the Light Wisps in her heirloom necklace awakened.

Light Wisps: A mysterious pixie that awakens from a necklace with the power to split itself. The split split can fuse with special stones to become a defense tower, and it seems to have some other functions?

Goblin Commander: One of the members who took part in the “Night of Broken Radiance” operation to destroy the Radiance Kingdom. After the operation, he was banished by the kobolds in the royal city and came to the border because he had taken in too much light scar energy and went berserk.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5+ / AMD Ryzen5+
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 460 / Radeon HD 7800 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7+ / AMD Ryzen7+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 / Radeon R9 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: This is a rogue-like tower defense game where players control Light Wisps. Players use Light Wisps to build defense towers and obtain Light Shards, which can be combined to create various Light Wisp attack patterns! Use these to defeat enemies and escort Princess Liana to save the world.
